prompt: Who was the first person to be an American diplomatic minister to Romania and Serbia?
answer: **Eugene Schuyler** was the first American diplomatic minister to both Romania and Serbia. He was appointed U.S. diplomatic agent to Romania in 1880 and, in 1882, became Minister Resident and Consul General to Romania and Serbia (also accredited to Greece).
